title: Junior Design Architect
description:
**Job Title : Design Architect**

Job Location: Kochi

Salary: **Up to ₹40,000 (Based on Experience)**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Drafting and Design:** Create detailed floor plans and elevations using software like AutoCAD, Revit, Rhino or InDesign  
**Project Support:** Assist senior architects with schematic designs, material research, and building code compliance.  
**Collaboration:** Coordinate with consultants, structural engineers, and contractors under indirect supervision.

**Qualifications and Skills**

**Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture (B.Arch / M.Arch).

**Software:** Strong technical proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit, Rhino, InDesign

**Soft Skills:** Clear verbal communication

Industry: Engineering Consultant

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated resumes to arsha@affable.in or contact 9539551003

Work Location: In person
